description: Subscribe one HTTPS receiver to database lifecycle events (database.created, ready, woke, slept, suspended, resized, deleted) of one Dev or Prod database, or to data events: data.<topic> for the rows of one watched table (the event type database_watch_create returns) or data.* for every watched table; a bare * never matches data events. The signing secret is RETURNED EXACTLY ONCE: store it in a secret manager and never write it into files, notes, source, commit messages or later messages. Deliveries are signed, retried and dead-lettered when retries stop. At most five webhooks exist per project environment. Requires confirmed: true and an idempotency key; the same key with the same request returns the stored answer.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_webhook_create
